selection_contract.claim_boundary: single-optimizer paired development evidence only; no reward, training, cross-seed, or publication claim
selection_contract.expansion_rule: advance to fresh optimizer multiseed only if all three environments pass
selection_contract.failure_rule: any mechanics, feasibility, or frequency failure stops expansion
selection_contract.feasibility_gate: mean current-step upper-budget feasibility is at least 0.99 and maximum reported upper-budget violation RMS is at most 1e-7
selection_contract.frequency_gate: every environment requires candidate upper HPF8 power at most 0.075^2; candidate lower LPF32 power at most 0.0475^2 and at least 10% below control; normalized joint merit must improve by at least 10%
selection_contract.mechanics_gate: all reward, executed-action, and latent-policy traces match exactly; explicit transition structure is valid; router and responsibility reconstruction RMS are at most 1e-7
selection_contract.paired_intervention: the same frozen checkpoint and heldout path is evaluated at strengths zero and one
selection_contract.training: one strength-zero policy with complete FIR audit state is trained once per environment
